name: What are trenchless water line repair methods?

mainEntity.name: What are trenchless water line repair methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trenchless water line repair methods offer alternatives to traditional open-trench excavation, minimizing damage to your landscaping, driveways, and foundations. Two common techniques are pipe bursting, where a new pipe is pulled through the old one, breaking it apart, and pipe lining, which involves inserting a new, smaller pipe or a resin-coated liner into the existing pipe. These methods are efficient, often quicker, and can be more cost-effective in the long run by avoiding extensive property restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trenchless methods like pipe bursting or pipe lining repair water lines without extensive digging, preserving landscaping and reducing disruption.
